sourcePolicy.movement_cost: dimensionless friction 1+(slope_degrees/10)^2 for valid slope <15 degrees; -9999 means unknown or blocked, distinguish by mask and hazard; not speed/time/energy
sourcePolicy.valid_data_mask: 1 = 3x3 DEM and image footprint valid; 0 = unknown; does not mean traversable or safe
sourcePolicy.hazard: illustrative slope classes 0:[0,5), 1:[5,10), 2:[10,15), 3:[15,90]; 255 unknown; not a validated safety hazard
sourcePolicy.astar: exclude cost NoData and prevent diagonal corner cutting; edge cost = spherical great-circle distance between cell centres times mean endpoint friction; admissible heuristic great-circle distance to goal times minimum friction 1
sourcePolicy.unknown_policy: unknown blocked; do not fill or interpolate

limitations: Research/demo only; not operational navigation or safety.
Physical image-to-DEM registration is not independently measured.
